summary: End-to-end test of the new Banker/Value/Banger LIVE sub-tabs. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (category filter partitioning, admin/live-run backfill, /admin/live-run auth-required, and _live_bet_landed for 'Asian Über 2.0 Tore' returning True/None/False at 3+/exactly 2/<=1 goals, plus _live_odd staying in [1.05, 15.0]). Frontend: three sub-tabs render with correct count pills (Banker 7 · Value 3 · Banger 0), explainer box (data-testid=live-cat-explain) changes text per sub-tab and resets to the default 'Live-Picks' copy when the active tab is clicked again, category badges on TipCards match the selected sub-tab (all BANKER on banker view, none of BANKER/BANGER on value view). Banger=0 is expected per review note (situational). live-run returned {posted:0, closed:0, live:0} and every live tip has category ∈ {banker,value,banger,risk} after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7494 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Live channel (live_autopost + helpers), settlement, admin endpoints, and the tips CRUD should be split into their own modules for maintainability. Not blocking, but the surface area for regressions keeps growing.

Block 4 (banger generation) reuses `stat_calls` counter from block 3 with the same LIVE_STAT_CALL_CAP. On a busy live day the fresh-picks loop will exhaust the cap before the banger loop even runs one iteration — consider a separate small budget for bangers (e.g. cap/2 each) so the banger channel never starves.

list_tips category filter treats 'value' as NOT IN [banker,risk,banger]. This means any tip with category=null or missing category also falls into 'value'. That is intentional per the comment, but front-end loadLiveCounts bins the SAME way (line 174), so member-posted live tips without a category will silently increment the Value pill. Fine today, worth documenting.

TipCard badge map (RateWall.jsx line 987-988) uses the same orange color for 'risk' and 'banger'. Since risk is a pre-match single-only concept and banger is live-only they never collide on the same card, but colour reuse could confuse an owner reviewing analytics. Consider distinct hues.

live_autopost block 1 backfills category based on `id.startswith('hqlive-banger-')` OR odds threshold. That is fine but means a legacy live pick posted before this iteration will be classified purely by odds — no `ai_analysis` update. Acceptable, but be aware old cards will now show a BANKER/VALUE badge that was never in the original analysis text.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all sub-tab, explainer, filter and badge assertions passed)

test_credentials: admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! — POST /api/auth/login body field 'username', response field 'token'.
seed_data_creation: None. Used only whatever the live_autopost had already produced (7 banker + 3 value + 0 banger).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Banger sub-tab correctly shows 0 in the preview environment because block 4 needs an in-play fixture (min 15-72) with <=1 goal, strong shot/corner pressure AND odds 1.40-2.60. Do NOT flag 0 as a bug — verify the code path returns JSON via /api/admin/live-run and every remaining live tip has category populated. Frontend load() adds category param only for view=='live' (RateWall.jsx L85), and loadLiveCounts fetches all live tips and buckets client-side (L168-179).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. Owner-verified behaviour confirmed: category filter partitioning is consistent, live-run backfill leaves no legacy null-category live tips, Asian Über 2.0 settlement returns None (push/void) at exactly 2 goals, True at 3+, False at 0-1, and the three UI sub-tabs filter correctly with contextual explainer copy in German.
